newsitem.title: UK: N.IRELAND POLICE PROBE KICK-BOXER'S MATCH DEATH.
newsitem.headline: N.IRELAND POLICE PROBE KICK-BOXER'S MATCH DEATH.

text.p: Norther Ireland police on Monday investigated the death of a kick boxer who collapsed and died in the ring in front of his family on Friday.
Sean McBride, 18, collapsed at the end of a bout in the town of Dungannon and did not regain consciousness. He died in a Belfast hospital on Sunday, his family said.
His parents and three sisters were at the bout, which featured the hybrid sport which mixes karate-style kicking and conventional boxing in gloves.
